common_affordance: The required lexicographically smallest assignment is aligned with uplink index order and increasing band labels, so ordered DFS/backtracking can search for the answer directly.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It commits permanently to the smallest locally available color for each uplink and never backtracks; a locally smallest choice can make a later valid three-coloring impossible.

recommended_edit: No mutable wording edit can remove this affordance without changing the immutable lexicographic-output requirement. If a presentation-only change is required, describe the result as the minimum among complete deployments under a controller policy rather than suggesting sequential assignment; this may discourage the shortcut but cannot eliminate the underlying structure.
